# Harriet Ainslie

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-fifties  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v5 c21 P28](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v5 c13 P12](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0012)</sub>
- **Status:** Engaged to Lionel Fairlie  <sub>[v5 c22 P10](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Glen St. Agnes / East Welby area  <sub>[v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 c7 P15](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0015), [v5 c13 P13](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0013)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Harriet Ainslie  <sub>[v4 c6 P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028)</sub>; Miss Harriet  <sub>[v4 c6 P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Harriet is a tall, large-framed, swarthy woman, a decade older than her sister Clementine, bearing dark hair, thick bushy black eyebrows, and eyes that match the transparent slaty-blue of gulf waters during a northerly breeze. She possesses a voice carrying a slight masculine quality, an energetic laugh, and an assertive, impressive presence. In her late fifties, she wears a new black velvet gown with a V-neck and a train, adorned with a heavy, family-relic amber bead necklace.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 c6 P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028), [v5 c13 P12](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0012), [v5 c22 P5](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0005)_

## Personality

Harriet is a sharp-tongued, firm-willed, and resolute woman with a keen intellect and a strong sense of humor. Although her stern, commanding exterior and blunt manner can be intimidating, she possesses a warm, honest, and unselfish nature devoid of malice or small-mindedness. She is a well-read, outspoken observer of global affairs who holds deep convictions, particularly regarding political threats such as German militarism. Despite her domineering and stubborn streak, she is deeply protective of her sister and capable of laughing at herself.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 c6 P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028), [v4 c6 P34](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0034), [v5 c13 P18](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0018), [v5 c22 P2](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0002)_

## History

Harriet grew up in an Episcopalian home near Glen St. Agnes. Following her father's early death and the loss of her younger brother, she cared for her invalid mother alongside her sister Clementine. In her youth, she was courted by Lionel Fairlie until a sudden quarrel parted them, prompting Lionel's impulsive marriage to another woman. Devastated by her mother's death when Clementine was twenty-five, Harriet extracted a solemn oath from her sister that neither would ever marry so they would never be parted. For decades, the two sisters resided at their hilltop stone house, Echo Cottage, tending to their garden, pets, and reading. Harriet engaged in spirited political debates with local visitors, including Rev. John Ashdown and Lionel Fairlie. When Lionel renewed his suit for Harriet's hand years later, Harriet initially held Clementine to their sacred oath. However, after realizing Clementine's deep feelings for Mr. Ashdown, Harriet released her sister from the vow, agreeing to marry Lionel Fairlie herself while Clementine prepared to marry Mr. Ashdown.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 c6 P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028), [v4 c11 P30](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0030), [v5 c6 P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 c13 P15](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0015), [v5 c13 P20](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0020), [v5 c13 P22](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0022), [v5 c22 P10](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0010), [v5 c22 P24](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0024), [v5 c22 P31](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0031)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of an Episcopalian family from Glen St. Agnes  <sub>[v4 c6 P15](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0015), [v4 c11 P25](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0025)</sub>
- Her father passed away when she was thirteen, and her brother five years later  <sub>[v5 c13 P20](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0020)</sub>
- Was courted in her youth by Lionel Fairlie until an argument ended their relationship  <sub>[v4 c11 P37](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0037), [v5 c15 P30](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0030)</sub>
